findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_case, get_law_section, whoami · Private data: get_court, filter_cases, get_case, get_similar_cases, get_law_section, get_case_references, get_cases_for_law, get_citing_cases, validate_citation, submit_feedback · Public sink: get_case_references, submit_feedback, whoami.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_case, get_law_section, whoami · Private data: get_court, filter_cases, get_case, get_similar_cases, get_law_section, get_case_references, get_cases_for_law, get_citing_cases, validate_citation, submit_feedback · Public sink: get_case_references, submit_feedback, whoami

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
